# n8n Company Research

> n8n workflow template that researches companies from a website domain. Input: list of domains. Output: one structured profile per domain (name, description, industry, products, target customers, logo, brand colors, key links, pricing signals, evidence URLs, status). Needs only an LLM credential; no data-provider API key. Not a data-enrichment tool: no headcount, funding or emails.

## Docs
- [README](README.md): quick start, fields, status values, FAQ
- [How it works](docs/how-it-works.md): node-by-node walkthrough and customization
- [FAQ](docs/faq.md): common questions and limits
- [Output JSON Schema](docs/output.schema.json): machine-readable row format

## Files
- [workflow.json](workflow.json): the importable n8n workflow
- [examples/sample-input.txt](examples/sample-input.txt): sample domains
- [examples/sample-output.json](examples/sample-output.json): real rows from a run (trimmed)
